$comment: Single source of truth for the upstream versions this repo's ports track. Bumping a port means updating BOTH the code (htmx.go Version const / ext/preload header) AND the matching 'pinned' value here. The scheduled upstream-watch GitHub Action reads this file and notifies (issue-only) when an upstream moves ahead of a pin. It never auto-updates.

preload.method: src/preload/package.json version on the default branch (no per-extension release tags exist)

sigv4.note: Gothic-original port of the AWS SigV4 body-hash signing algorithm. There is no upstream JS package to diff against; a human periodically reviews the AWS SigV4 specification. The watcher emits an informational note only and never flags drift.
